name: Morph
summary: One box whose content changes state in place (Q65 P3, strategy S2, "fake the content"): the box stays, the old content fades out quickly on top while the new one fades in under it, and the height eases between them. Nothing blinks out and back: a dialog's form becomes its result, a card's skeleton becomes its content, a thinking row becomes the answer. A quick change of mind reverses from where it is (the leaving content comes back). Not for a value that changes within one control (its own transition), something opening in place (Reveal), or something arriving from nowhere (presence).
a11y: The leaving content is `inert` and `aria-hidden` from its first frame (M13). If focus was inside it, focus moves first to the new content's `[data-morph-focus]` element, else its first focusable element, else the new content itself. The new state is announced by its owner through the status region, never by the fade. First render never animates (Z19). Reduced motion: the height snaps; the content still cross-fades.

props.name: state
props.description: Names the state being shown, e.g. `form`, `done`, `failed`, `loading`. A new value morphs to the new content in the same box; the same value keeps it. Morph into a state that is ready (M12): while it's being fetched, keep the current state and show its own pending sign.

props.name: size
props.description: How the box's size follows the content: `layout` (default) animates its height from the old content's to the new one's, moving what follows (the one layout animation an interaction may have, R3); `hold` keeps the box at its new size at once, for a box whose size doesn't change or whose neighbours mustn't move.

props.name: motion
props.description: How the layers cross: `fade` (default); `zoom-out` / `zoom-in` for a change of level (a calendar's month to its year and back, C21): the layers also scale by `motion.zoom-scale` the way the level moves; `none` swaps at once, for a change the person drives step by step with keys (Z8). Reduced motion: the zooms only fade.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the current state.
